main_text.p: נאותים בהן ועל lignum, ut Sacerdo- חפרה שלא יהו tes ex illis aliquam מועלין באפרה ועל utilitatem recipiant: הקינין הפסולות שיהו Item circa vaccæ באורת משל ציבור ר rufæ cineres, ne illæ יוסי אומר המספק in usum eorum ce- את הקינין מספק את dant. Item ut loco הפסולורת : turturum illegitima- Ecclesiæ parentur: rum, aliæ sumptu R. Iose dicit, quod
ille qui de turturibus prospicit, etiam locò illegitimarum prospiciat.
main_text.head: NOTÆ.
main_text.p: (1) Referunt pecunias repertas ad illud quod propius est, ut ita facilitati studeant, & simul significent illud minus æstimandum esse; illud vero quod in medio reperitur, relegant ad illud quod magis æstimatur. Ita consueta apud Magistros est formula argumentandi מק׳ ודומר à minori ad majus. (2) תעובר צורתו מעגירין אותן מלגניהם עד שיפסלו בנותר : Quæ permutarunt figuram suam &c. id est, quæ tamdiu manibus hominum tritæ fuerunt, ut quasi aridæ, iam illegitimæ sint. Gloss. (3) Erat focus in templo in quo reliquia ossa holocaustorum & alia frusta sacrificiorum in cineres redigebantur; In illum etiam relegebant carnes de quibus sermo in Mišna. (4) De MigdalEder vid. pag.355.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek passages are only approximately legible at this scan resolution; the Hebrew in the parallel column and the Hebrew/Greek note (2) are uncertain and the Hebrew quotation in the formula line is doubtful. Page is faded with stains at several points. The printed "pag.355" is uncertain. Right-hand Latin column text of the parallel block was read from the scan and may contain small errors.
